fullContentHtml:
SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Shri Krishna Ayush University (SKAU) has released the Admit Card for the post of Staff Nurse, Ayurvedic Pharmacist & Clerk. This recruitment was released for 60 posts. Applications for the SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 30 July 2026 to 21 August 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 10-14 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 30 July 2026
  • Last Date : 21 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 10-14 October 2026
  • Admit Card : 08 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General & Other State : Rs. 1500/-
  • Haryana Reserve Category : Rs. 750/-
  • PwBD Candidate : Rs. 00/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Important Links

  • Download Admit Card
  • Download Exam Date Notice
  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post Admit Card 2026?

SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post Admit Card 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
